Effects: 1: Increase STR by 29 (L39) to 42 (L65); 2: Increase Absorb Damage by 79 (L39) to 90 (L50); 3: Decrease AGI by 20

Root.name: Root
lines: Overview: Causes the earth to adhere to your target's feet, preventing them from moving for up to 48 secs.

Scourge.name: Scourge
lines: Overview: Sickens your target with a fever, causing 40 damage initially and 24 damage every six seconds for 2.1 minutes for a total of 544 damage. 3.2 Damage per mana
Effects: 1: Increase Disease Counter by 4; 2: Decrease Hitpoints by 24 per tick; 3: Decrease HP when cast by 40

Screaming_Mace.name: Screaming Mace
lines: Overview: The proc is a small three-tick STR and AC buff, very similar to Yaulp used by clerics and paladins.

Sha's_Lethargy.name: Sha's Lethargy
lines: Overview: Causes your target to fall into a lethargic state, slowing their attack speed.
Effects: 2: Decrease Attack Speed by 30%; 3: Increase Disease Counter by 12
Duration: 2 min 42 sec to 3 min 24 sec

Shallow_Breath.name: Shallow Breath
lines: Overview: Constricts your target's throat, causing between 3 and 5 damage, as well as lowering their strength and agility for 18 secs (3 ticks).
Effects: 1: Decrease HP when cast by 3 (L1) to 5 (L4); 2: Decrease STR by 5; 3: Decrease AGI by 5

Shield_of_Brambles.name: Shield of Brambles
lines: Overview: Surrounds your target in a shield of brambles that cause damage to anything that strikes them.
Effects: 1: Increase Damage Shield by 11 (L29) to 12 (L32)

Shock_of_Fire.name: Shock of Fire
lines: Overview: Surrounds your target in fire, causing between 14 and 20 damage.

Sicken.name: Sicken
lines: Overview: Sickens your target with a fever, causing 8 damage initially and 2 damage every six seconds for 2.1 mins (Max Damage: 50). 1.67 DPM.
Effects: 1: Increase Disease Counter by 1; 2: Decrease Hitpoints by 2 per tick; 3: Decrease HP when cast by 8

Siphon.name: Siphon
lines: Overview: Drains life energy from your target, siphoning 80 health.
Effects: 1: Decrease Hitpoints by 80; 2: Increase Hitpoints by 80 (Self)

Soul_Leech.name: Soul Leech
lines: Overview: Drains your target of life energy, siphoning between 75 and @1 damage.

Steal_Strength.name: Steal Strength
lines: Overview: Weapon proc. Superior to Siphon Strength.

Strong_Poison.name: Strong Poison
lines: Overview: Poisons your target, causing 30 damage initially and 14 damage every 6 seconds for up to 2 minutes.
Effects: 1: Increase Poison Counter by 4; 2: Decrease HP when cast by 30; 3: Decrease Hitpoints by 14 per tick

Stun.name: Stun
lines: Overview: Strikes an enemy with holy power, briefly stunning them. This spell works on creatures up to level 55.
Effects: 1: Stun for 4.0 seconds up to level 55

Tagar's_Insects.name: Tagar's Insects
lines: Overview: Engulfs your target in a swarm of insects, slowing their attack rate for 1.5 mins @L29 to 3.0 mins @L60.
Effects: 2: Decrease Attack Speed by 34% (L29) to 50% (L60); 3: Increase Disease Counter by 9

Tashania.name: Tashania
lines: Overview: Causes your target's ears to echo with the barking of Tashan, lowering their magic resistance.
Effects: 1: Increase Poison Counter by 1; 2: Decrease Magic Resist by 31 (L44) to 33 (L48)

Tishan's_Clash.name: Tishan's Clash
lines: Overview: Strikes your target with energy, stunning them briefly and causing between 29 and 50 damage. Superseded by Markar's Clash. Mana efficiency is .44 / .77 DPM.
Effects: 1: Stun for 5.0* seconds; 2: Decrease Hitpoints by 30 (L20) to 50 (L40)

Ward_Summoned.name: Ward Summoned
lines: Overview: A burst of holy power that inflicts between 35 and 41 damage to a summoned target.

Ward_Undead.name: Ward Undead
lines: Overview: A burst of holy power that inflicts between 35 and 41 damage to an undead target. 1.37 DPM

Weak_Poison.name: Weak Poison
lines: Overview: Poisons your target, causing 6 damage initially and 6 damage every 6 seconds for up to 1 min.
Effects: 1: Increase Poison Counter by 2; 2: Decrease HP when cast by 6; 3: Decrease Hitpoints by 6 per tick

Weaken.name: Weaken
lines: Overview: Weakens your opponent, lowering their strength.

Whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
lines: Overview: A whirlwind traps your target in the air, causing a great spin as well as 100 damage.
Effects: 1: Levitate(1); 2: SpinStun; 3: Decrease HP when cast by 100

Winter's_Roar.name: Winter's Roar
lines: Overview: Creates a rift of bitter cold, causing between 251 and 263 damage to your target. 1.75 DPM at lv. 40.

Word_of_Pain.name: Word of Pain
lines: Overview: A forbidden word that causes between 24 and 29 damage to all nearby enemies.

Word_of_Shadow.name: Word of Shadow
lines: Overview: A forbidden word that causes between 52 and 58 damage to all nearby enemies.

Yaulp_II.name: Yaulp II
lines: Overview: Focuses your spiritual energy into a great battle cry, increasing your strength and armor class for 24 secs (4 ticks). It does not stack with Speed of the Shissar.
Effects: 2: Increase AC by 8; 3: Increase STR by 20; 4: Decrease Stamina Loss by 1

Yaulp_III.name: Yaulp III
lines: Overview: Focuses your spiritual energy into a great battle cry, increasing your strength and armor class for 24 secs (4 ticks). It does not stack with Speed of the Shissar or Armor of Protection.
Effects: 2: Increase AC by 12; 3: Increase STR by 30; 4: Decrease Stamina Loss by 7

Ykesha.name: Ykesha
lines: Overview: This DD proc will interrupt spells and cause 475 hate.
Effects: 1: Decrease Hitpoints by 75; 2: Stun for 0.0 seconds

Leech.name: Leech
lines: Overview: Drains the life from your target, doing 8 damage every six seconds for 54s and healing you for the damage dealt.
Effects: Decrease Hitpoints by 8 per tick; heal caster for the damage dealt

Mistwalker.name: Mistwalker
lines: Overview: Summons a mistwalker wolf pet that fights for 2 seconds.
